newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar unchanged in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar unchanged in dull trade.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were unchanged in thin midsession dealings, floor sources said.
At 1130 EDT, benchmark July was 0.01 cent firmer at 11.06 cents a lb, traded 11.06 to 11.01 cents. Second-position October was 0.02 weaker at 10.83 cents.
An estimated 1,739 lots changed hands as of 1100.
Floor sources said steady buying in the July/October switch supported the market, while the commission houses were cited as the main sellers.
Activity is expected to remain dull ahead of the U.S. Cane Sugar Refiners' Association dinner next week.
"A lot of people are already leaving homes and heading for New York," a dealer said, noting extremely thin dealings in London.
Support remained at 10.85 cents for July delivery, with resistance at 11.11 cents and then 11.20 cents.
